name: opencode-worker
description: Use OpenCode as Codex's persistent implementation executor with guarded runs and post-run gap checks.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate implementation tasks to OpenCode and verify the result.
interface.longDescription: Use OpenCode Worker when Codex should plan/review while OpenCode executes implementation-sized coding tasks. The plugin launches, monitors, and waits for non-interactive OpenCode runs, prevents overlapping jobs, exposes no interrupt or kill command, and reinforces a post-run run-summary/logs/changed-files/gap-check loop.
defaultPrompt: Plan this change, then delegate the implementation to OpenCode.
Use OpenCode as the default executor for this project's implementation tasks.
Check whether OpenCode is running and wait for it.
Create an OpenCode delegation prompt with acceptance criteria and verification commands.
Summarize the last OpenCode run and identify verification gaps.
Show the latest OpenCode worker logs.
